images.alt: Four small workstations in a row on a bench, linked by a thin line, with a paper ticket travelling between them and a coin slot of a different size beside each.
images.prompt: Four small workstations in a row on a long bench, centred in the frame with wide margins: a drafting table, a lantern over a map, a bench with hand tools, and a magnifying lens on a stand. A single paper ticket travels between them along a thin line. Beside each station sits a coin slot, and the four slots are visibly different sizes. Nothing else on the bench.

images.alt: Five boxes on a shelf reach down to a shared tray of tickets; one box is unplugged and its ticket is pinned back on the tray with a clip.
images.prompt: A row of five identical compute boxes on a shelf, centred in the frame, each with a short arm reaching down to one shared tray of paper tickets sitting below them. One box is unplugged and dark, and its half-finished ticket has been pinned back onto the tray with a small bookmark clip so a neighbouring box can pick it up. Plenty of empty wall around the shelf.

images.alt: A large sphere has absorbed three of four shelves of small machines; the top shelf, holding one card-index box, stands apart above it.
images.prompt: A stack of four shelves on the left half of the frame, each holding a small mechanical contraption. A large smooth sphere on the right has rolled over and swallowed the bottom three shelves, which are visible as faint outlines inside it. The top shelf, holding a single card-index box, stands untouched above the sphere. Everything sits well inside the frame with open space around it.
